full_run.command: bash scripts/run_from_head.sh python -m pytest -q (TMPDIR inside the checkout)

reruns.command: run_from_head with the system temporary folder: tests/test_verify_eval.py
reruns.skipped_test: test_git_clean_on_the_repository (an export is not a git checkout)

reruns.command: in the checkout: tests/test_verify_eval.py -k 'git_clean or protocol_refusals'

explanation: The two failures of the full run are an artefact of where the code export was placed: TMPDIR pointed inside the checkout (results/runs/tmp, untracked), so git saw the export's configs as untracked files of the repository and the two git-state tests failed. With the export outside the checkout the protocol test passes, and the git-state test, which needs a real checkout, passes in the checkout itself. No code changed between the runs.
